errorConnectionErrorApp.message: Cannot connect to KeeWebX, please check if KeeWebX is open and browser integration is enabled in settings.

errorConnectionErrorWeb.message: Cannot connect to KeeWebX, refreshing a tab with KeeWebX may help. Inspect the extension background page to get more details.

errorBrowserTabNoPermissions.message: Permission to access $1 was not granted.

errorRequestTimeout.message: KeeWebX didn't respond to our request in time.

optionsIntro.message: This is a browser extension for KeeWebX, a modern open-source KeePass-compatible password manager.

optionsConnectionModeApp.message: Using the native app. This is the most convenient mode of integration: KeeWebX runs in background, the extension connects to the app to fetch credentials. If you don't have the app installed:

optionsConnectionModeAppOnly.message: To use the extension, you need to install the KeeWebX app. The app runs in background and the extension connects to it to fetch passwords. If you don't have the app installed:

optionsConnectionModeWeb.message: Web-only: you need to have a tab with KeeWebX open, the extension connects to this tab. It's less convenient, however you don't have to install a desktop app:

optionsWebConnectionTabPermission.message: To connect to the KeeWebX tab, we need a special permission, otherwise it won't be possible to communicate with this tab. Click this button to grant the necessary permission to the extension:

optionsVaultModeFull.message: Full mode: keep the vault inside this extension (local files and WebDAV)

optionsVaultModeConnect.message: Connect mode: use KeeWebX open in a browser tab

optionsWebConnectionKeeWebUrl.message: KeeWebX URL (change it if you're using your own self-hosted version):

optionsWebConnectionKeeWebUrlDisallowedS.message: URL must use https://, file://, or http://localhost

optionsUsageIntro.message: Now when you're successfully connected to KeeWebX, it's time to use the extension!

optionsUsageButton.message: Put your cursor to a field on any page, then click the extension button to auto-fill the form:

optionsUsageShortcut.message: Instead of clicking the button, you can also use a keyboard shortcut that you can change below.

optionsUsageShortcutNoChange.message: Instead of clicking the button, you can also use a keyboard shortcut $1.

optionsUsagePermissionsPerSite.message: Sometimes additional permissions are required to auto-fill passwords. If you see this warning sign, click the extension button to grant necessary permissions:

optionsUsageMenu.message: Alternatively, select a desired option from the KeeWebX menu:

optionsShortcutsDescription.message: You can change shortcuts in the extension shortcuts settings.

optionsShortcutsDescriptionNoChange.message: You can use these shortcuts to submit forms faster.

optionsShortcutsManual.message: To edit shortcuts, open add-ons in your browser, then click the settings button, and select the shortcuts item:

optionsAboutContact.message: You can ask a question, suggest an idea, or submit an issue report here:

syncStateOffline.message: Offline. Changes are kept in this browser and will sync when the storage is reachable.

syncStateError.message: Sync failed. Open KeeWebX to fix it.

uiWebNotOpenHint.message: Open it in a tab and unlock your vault. Your logins then show up here.

uiWebUnlockHint.message: Unlock in the KeeWebX tab, with your password or a passkey.

uiWebApprove.message: Allow access in the KeeWebX tab

uiWebApproveHint.message: KeeWebX asks once whether this extension may list your logins.

uiWebOldApp.message: Logins come from KeeWebX open in a browser tab. You pick the login there.

uiFullModeHint.message: The vault opens inside this extension. Nothing else needs to be open.

uiWebModeHint.message: Logins come from KeeWebX open in a browser tab, on keewebx.app or your own server.

uiAutoLockHint.message: Locks the vault after this long without use

uiClearClipboardHint.message: Empties the clipboard this long after you copy a field

uiLockWithScreenHint.message: Locks the vault when your computer locks

uiShortcutHint.message: Change it on the browser's extension shortcuts page

uiErrorFullUrl.message: Enter a full address, like https://vault.example.com

uiErrorNoAnswer.message: The extension did not answer. Try again.
